Neither option matches. The World Bank's 2019 estimate is about 8.6% of the world population (roughly 650 million people) below $1.90 a day, so the closest choice is 5%, and 25% is far off. I'm keeping my earlier answer of about 8%, though I'd recommend checking the team's note against the World Bank's Poverty and Inequality Platform before relying on it.

CONFIDENCE: 85
